Style: hyperrealistic business workplace photography, cinematic-realistic lighting, ultra-clear 8K resolution, cool white office illumination, transparent clean image. In a modern minimalist meeting room with glass walls, dark metal window frames, a smooth light wood conference table, and a softly blurred urban skyline outside, a young East Asian female business professional stands in left profile beside a large projection screen. She appears to be in her late 20s to early 30s, with fair skin, an oval face, refined natural makeup, defined brows, subtle eyeliner, light blush, and muted rose lipstick. Her dark brown to black hair is neatly pulled back into a low bun. She wears a fitted matte white tailored commuting suit consisting of a blazer and matching trousers. Her posture is upright and confident; her right hand holds a small black presentation remote, while her left arm is extended naturally toward the screen, index finger pointing at the upper portion of the slide. Her mouth is slightly open as if explaining, and her gaze is directed toward the audience members seated in front of her. The lower foreground contains blurred attendees seen from behind, including dark-haired heads and shoulders, reinforcing the meeting-room presentation context. Subtle ambient sounds include soft HVAC hum, faint city ambience through the windows, quiet chair movement, keyboard typing, paper handling, and gentle discussion tones.

The large widescreen projection dominates the center-right of the image, tilted slightly by perspective, with a bright white surface, thin dark border, and sharp readable typography. The slide uses a clean corporate technical layout with dark gray Chinese text, bold section titles, circular numbered markers, and three vertical content columns. At the top-left of the slide, the main title reads "扩散模型 (Diffusion Models) 核心技术详解", followed directly below by the subtitle "—— 从原理到工程实践 ——". On the far left of the slide, a numbered outline runs vertically with filled circular number icons and dark text. The first item reads "1. 核心思想与动机"; its paragraph states "扩散模型的核心思想是学习数据分布的渐进式去噪过程。它通过在前向过程中逐步添加噪声，并在反向过程中逐步去噪，从而实现对复杂数据分布的高效建模。" The second item reads "2. 前向加噪过程（Forward Diffusion）"; its body states "在时间步 t = 0, 1, ..., T 中，按照预设的噪声调度逐渐向数据添加高斯噪声，直到得到纯噪声。前向过程是马尔可夫链： q(x_t | x_{t-1}) = 𝒩(x_t; √(1 - β_t)x_{t-1}, β_t I)". The third item reads "3. 反向去噪过程（Reverse Diffusion）"; its explanatory text states "学习一个神经网络 s_θ(·) 来预测每一步的噪声，从而逆向生成数据分布： p_θ(x_{t-1} | x_t) = 𝒩(x_{t-1}; μ_θ(x_t,t), Σ_θ(x_t,t)) 其中： μ_θ(x_t,t) = 1/√α_t (x_t - β_t/√(1 - ᾱ_t) ε_θ(x_t,t)) Σ_θ(x_t,t) = β_t I". The fourth item reads "4. 损失函数与训练目标"; the formula line reads "ℒ = 𝔼_{t∼U(1,T),ε∼𝒩(0,I)} [||ε - ε_θ(x_t,t)||_2^2]". The fifth item reads "5. 采样流程（DDIM / DPM-Solver 等）"; its paragraph states "通过改进的采样器（如 DDIM、DPM-Solver）在更少步数内完成高质量生成，平衡效率与质量。" The sixth item reads "6. 工程实践要点"; its bullets read "• 噪声调度策略（Linear / Cosine / Quad） • 网络结构设计（UNet / DiT） • 数据增强与正则化技巧 • 分布式训练与显存优化" The seventh item reads "7. 应用方向"; its bullets read "• 图像生成 • 视频生成 • 3D 内容生成 • 语音合成 • 科学计算与分子设计". Across the top-right of the slide, the second section heading reads "2. 扩散模型工作流总览". Beneath it is a horizontal process diagram made of four rounded rectangular boxes connected by dark arrows pointing left-to-right. The first box has a label above it reading "原始数据 x_0" and contains the caption "真实数据分布 p_data(x_0)" with a small grayscale landscape thumbnail below. The second box has a label reading "前向加噪过程 q(x_t|x_0)" and shows progressively noisier grayscale thumbnails, with the caption "逐步添加高斯噪声得到 x_T ~ 𝒩(0,I)". The third box has a label reading "反向去噪过程 p_θ(x_{t-1}|x_t)" and includes smaller noisy thumbnails with a downward arrow to a cleaner image, labeled "神经网络逐步去噪". The fourth box has a label reading "生成结果 x_0" and shows a clearer grayscale mountain-valley image near the bottom, labeled "高质量样本". Along the bottom-right of the slide, the third section heading reads "3. 典型应用场景与案例". Below it are three rounded rectangular cards with light borders and internal thumbnails. The first card title reads "图像生成（Image Generation）"; inside it is a realistic mountain lake landscape thumbnail and the caption "从噪声到高质量图像的逐步生成过程". The second card title reads "视频生成（Video Generation）"; it contains a small grayscale video-frame strip with several mountain scenes separated by plus signs, followed by the caption "扩散模型在视频领域的时序建模与生成". The third card title reads "跨模态生成（Text-to-Image）"; it contains a mountain-lake thumbnail with the caption "结合文本条件（Prompt）进行可控生成". The overall slide maintains a restrained monochrome palette, precise grid alignment, thin divider lines, rounded containers, and flat technical icons, giving the presentation a professional academic-engineering appearance.

超写实商务职场摄影，超清 8K，室内现代化简约会议室，明亮柔和办公冷白光，通透干净画面。一位气质干练的年轻东亚女性白领，精致淡妆，利落低盘发，穿着合身高级哑光白色通勤西装，站姿挺拔自信，侧身面向参会人员，右手自然抬起指向投影幕布，嘴巴微张正在讲解汇报，眼神专注专业，神态从容大方，皮肤质感真实细腻，光影均匀高级。
画面中心是超大高清投影幕布，幕布清晰明亮、无反光模糊，屏幕上是中文专业技术 PPT 页面，排版工整、字体清晰可读，页面内容为扩散模型核心技术讲解文本，尽可能详细阐述
